metadata.description: Plugins for AI coding agents: skills, commands, agents and hooks distilled from real engineering work.

plugins.name: python-lambda
plugins.description: Modernize Python AWS Lambda services: Python 3.14, uv with a dependency cooldown, pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.0, aws-cdk v2, and Chalice to FastAPI on Mangum.

plugins.name: repo-audit
plugins.description: Check a repository against its own code: README accuracy against the code, and a security review covering cloud IaC, CI/CD, supply chain and AI coding-agent configuration.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Write an implementation plan, review it, then execute it task by task with subagents and an external code review.

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: Collaborative design dialogue: from an idea to approaches, a design and a plan.

plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Second opinions and analysis: ask Codex, dialectic analysis, root-cause investigation.
